subject: sound-effect-generation
seam: packages/compositions/src/AudioTracks.tsx places voice and music only; DataRace has no audio track; ADR 007 names optional SFX. Event frames come from computeTimingPlan before render (fixtures/sample-data-race.timing-plan.json, DataRace/state.ts start_frame)
target: sync points sharing a generated mixed track with another event (cannot be levelled or muted alone)
floor: sync error per event: 0 frames when the cue from is the plan frame
chosen_to_falsify: the technique says the picture is the timing brief; here the picture is computed from a plan, so a caught outcome is a tree where the plan outranks the picture
result: sample cut 1230 frames (41 s), 11 sync points (6 cards, 4 cuts, 1 leader change), min gap 1.07 s. Picture-conditioned in 8 s windows: 6 clips [2,1,3,2,3,0], 10/11 events share a clip; 10 s windows: 11/11. Plan-spotted: 11 stems, 0 shared, 0-frame error
shipped: nothing: no SFX exists yet to place
open: when the first SFX cue is wired, read its from from the plan event frame and declare its anchor: onset (start_frame) or settle (+CARD.enterFrames=14)

subject: data-video-art-direction

target: cards whose dated year disagrees with the plan period they appear at: accepted by A, refused by B (new test red on old rules, green on new)
floor: all 3 committed fixtures (17 events) match and stay accepted; 1640 vitest, tsc, biome ratchet green
chosen_to_falsify: the project already meets the sizes, one-card and dated-label rules; a caught outcome would be a gate that already tied the label to the clock
result: no existing check tied them; 17 of 17 fixture events already conformed
not_measured: how often a generated card carries a mismatched year; labels without a year are not checked
return: count date-label-period refusals from the generation job log
